title: Perceptual Machines

governing_body.note: Provider address remains inside Workshop custody.

perceptual_job: Make documentary transformation, movement, and construction easier to perceive without strengthening the source beneath them.
current_physics: Inversion tests support; it does not manufacture support.
Unresolved and refusal are successful states.
open: Whether these remain separate instruments, become one cabinet, cross into film grammar, or produce bounded public specimens remains unresolved.

one.label: Machine one
one.name: Testimony / Proposition
one.question: What happens after a person says it?
one.brake: HEARD / WAS TOLD ≠ EXAMINER SUPPLIES ≠ SUPPOSES ≠ KNOWS.

two.label: Machine two
two.name: Field / Route
two.question: What movement is actually earned?
two.brake: PLACE REFERENCE ≠ ROUTE. ADMINISTRATIVE MEMORY ≠ PHYSICAL TRAVEL. NAMED ≠ PRESENT.

three.label: Machine three
three.name: Answer / Construction Inversion
three.question: What had to happen for this answer to become possible?
three.brake: Opening the construction does not overturn the answer. A useful result can be: the present source body does not yet earn this answer.

lineage.text: A perceptual-machine idea became clear enough to catch, but not clear enough to force into production.
The concept was put down where another mind could encounter it without inheriting an assignment.
A working specimen gave the idea visible mechanics and made it inspectable as an object.
Machine one and two could work together; a third neighboring machine became visible when the direction was reversed.
The Workshop recognized its inventions as things with lineage: low attachment, high attention, enough trace to inherit.

hugh-bell.title: Hugh G. Bell — bounded testimony unfold

heard.question: What did Hugh carry himself?
heard.answer: Hugh carries a heard / was told state about Robert.
heard.limit: The instrument does not upgrade it into personal knowledge.

supplied.question: What wording did the examiner supply?
supplied.answer: The examiner supplies the more specific council / vote / membership formulation.
supplied.limit: The wording entering through the question remains examiner-supplied unless Hugh independently adopts it.

knows.question: What does Hugh finally say he knows?
knows.answer: Asked whether he knows, Hugh answers: No, I don't.
knows.limit: The qualification remains part of the evidentiary state; it is not smoothed away.

trace.statement: Hugh reports what he had heard about Robert Bell.
More specific council / vote / membership wording enters through the question.

trace.brake: Tentative assent does not silently strengthen itself.

trace.statement: Asked whether he knows, Hugh answers that he does not.
A later administrative body may assess sufficiency or summarize the record.
trace.brake: Any forward edge must remain carrier-local and explicitly earned.

ground.title: Soft working ground · perceptual-machine family
ground.note: The family presently stands near film work, source-audit practice, Prose Map / Historical Ground, and the Workshop's documentation grammar.
ground.brake: Blank ground may be accurate. A missing road can remain missing. Refusal is a successful action.
